hooks.command:
python3 -c "import json,re,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
f=(d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path') or (d.get('tool_response') or {}).get('filePath') or ''
m=re.search(r'Modules/([^/]+)/(app|routes|database|config)/', f)
if m:
    mod=m.group(1)
    msg='This edit touched Modules/'+mod+'/. If it changed a model, service, API route, enum, or a documented business rule, update Modules/'+mod+'/docs/README.md in this same turn (see the Module Documentation section in CLAUDE.md).'
    print(json.dumps({'hookSpecificOutput':{'hookEventName':'PostToolUse','additionalContext':msg}}))
" 2>/dev/null || true
